Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Round Wood 2-Tier Shelf Floating Hanging Wall Unit- 30 Inch, Whitewashed Fir Veneer
Materials: Wood
Add a vintage flair to your walls with this rustic shelving unit. The fir veneer subtly peers through the whitewash, and the 2 shelves offer ample storage. Mount this unit to your wall via the elegant iron hook at the top. 30.12"H x 23.62"W x 4.92"D 85% medium-density fibreboard with fir veneer; 15% fir Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
